title: Wizard’s Chess!🧙🏻‍♂️
transcript: Do you remember watching these scenes as a child and dreaming of the day that technology could make Wizards Chess a reality? Well, I have some news for you. What's in front of me is the Go Chess Wizard with self-moving pieces. As you can see, the board moves the pieces for you, almost like magic. You can be playing against a board that almost has a life of its own. This is quite literally something that I used to dream about as a kid, even before I was into chess. But how does this actually work? Because there doesn't seem to be any engine on the board and the pieces themselves don't have any wheels or anything like that. These are just normal little pieces. I might just leave you guessing. You can just see the pieces moving themselves and suspend disbelief. And the look and shape of these pieces is an exact replica of the ones in the movie, which I think is pretty cool. But anyway, if you like this board, I'm going to leave a link to it in my bio. As a big Potterhead, this is an incredible moment of my life. I get to finally be able to play Wizards Chess on a real physical board. Thank you, Go Chess, for creating something that we have all been dreaming about for years and years.
